limitations: Repository HEAD and dashboards are independent snapshots; no exact source commit for the historical 72B deployment was established.
The published paper's BPB plot and the dashboard API captured on 2026-10-29 are separate observations: the paper plot ends around outer step 6190, while the dashboard API series ends at step 6410.

The 72B view exposes a global BPB curve and benchmark series. The paper plots aggregate contributing-peer and unique-participant curves, while the evaluated-miner endpoint returns only a count and the visible incentive table has no rows; individual contribution scores or UIDs are unavailable, and paper-plot points were not digitized.
The selected 72B page also loads the newer Qwen pipeline API using its explicit Qwen run_id. Those series are kept separate and are not treated as 72B data.
No model weights or datasets were fetched.
